items.title: Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1957-04-20
items.q: Yeah, I had Buddy Pitti working for them when I couldn't, I put him in the other hall

ctx.x: Well, I'd say about two months time I was gone. About two months you were, you had it, huh? and later then I found out the guys were making so much money off of me and I chartered two haul on late days. stuff

you know, before I left. You, you said? Economy Hall and Cooperative Hall. What? I, I tied them up for a whole year, you see. I rent both halls and I promote. Is that so? Yeah, I had Buddy Pitti working for them when I couldn't, I put him in the other hall and couldn't get in my place with the old guy.
So he's making money off both of them. So, so you. And some of them he rented, you didn't tell, and kept dark.
